europe_now.title: Moldova Summons Russian Envoy Over Drone Incursions
europe_now.summary: Moldova has officially summoned Russia's envoy following multiple drone incursions into its airspace. The diplomatic move highlights escalating regional security tensions on the border of the European Union.

europe_now.title: EU Proposes New Loan for Ukraine
europe_now.summary: The European Union has proposed a substantial new financial package for Ukraine intended to be supported by Russian assets. Meanwhile, fighting in the eastern region continues to prompt rising civilian evacuations.
